programme.title: Football - Wwin Liga BiH / Fudbal - WWin Liga BiH
programme.desc: Founded in 2000, the Premier League of Bosnia and Herzegovina is the highest rank of football competitions in BiH. With the entry of cubes from Republika Srpska, two years later, the league receives a format with 16 clubs in the two -round competition system. Today, 12 clubs compete in the league, which after 22 rounds are divided into the Champions League and League to stay. The first historic champion of BiH was Leotar from Trebinje. The club with the highest championship titles Zrinjski is from Mostar. The greatest European success is the placement of Željezničar in the UEFA semi -finals in 1984. / Osnovana 2000. godine Premijer liga Bosne i Hercegovine najviši je rang nogometnih natjecanja u BiH. Ulaskom kubova iz Republike Srpske dvije godine kasnije liga dobiva format sa 16 klubova u dvokružnom sistemu natjecanja. Danas se u ligi natječe 12 klubova koje se nakon 22 odigrana kola dijele na Ligu za prvaka i Ligu za ostanak. Prvi povijesni prvak BiH bio je Leotar iz Trebinja. Klub s najviše osvojenih naslova prvaka Zrinjski je iz Mostara. Najveći europski uspjeh plasman je Željezničara u polufinale kupa UEFA 1984. godine.

programme.title: Football - English League / Fudbal - Engleska liga
programme.desc: Every August 20 team begins hunting at the most respected trophy of English football. The English Premier in the format in which the game was founded in 1992. As a continuation of the English League founded back in 1888. The season lasts to May in the two-circular system where each team plays 38 games. The first winter of the championship is the most trophy English football club, Manchester United. Being a champion of England is a goal that weighs every player of the Premier League. / Svakog avgusta 20 ekipa započinje lov na najcenjeniji trofej engleskog fudbala. Engleska Premier liga u formatu u kojem se danas igra osnovana je 1992. godine kao nastavak na Englesku ligu osnovanu davne 1888. Sezona traje do maja u dvokružnom sistemu gde svaka ekipa kroz sezonu odigra 38 utakmica. Prvi osvajač prvenstva je najtrofejniji engleski fudbalski klub, Mančester Junajted. Biti prvak Engleske je cilj kojem teži svaki igrač Premier lige.

programme.title: Football - Wwin Liga BiH / Fudbal - WWin Liga BiH
programme.desc: Founded in 2000, the Premier League of Bosnia and Herzegovina is the highest rank of football competitions in BiH. With the entry of cubes from Republika Srpska, two years later, the league receives a format with 16 clubs in the two -round competition system. Today, 12 clubs compete in the league, which after 22 rounds are divided into the Champions League and League to stay. The first historic champion of BiH was Leotar from Trebinje. The club with the highest championship titles Zrinjski is from Mostar. The greatest European success is the placement of Željezničar in the UEFA semi -finals in 1984. / Osnovana 2000. godine Premijer liga Bosne i Hercegovine najviši je rang nogometnih natjecanja u BiH. Ulaskom kubova iz Republike Srpske dvije godine kasnije liga dobiva format sa 16 klubova u dvokružnom sistemu natjecanja. Danas se u ligi natječe 12 klubova koje se nakon 22 odigrana kola dijele na Ligu za prvaka i Ligu za ostanak. Prvi povijesni prvak BiH bio je Leotar iz Trebinja. programme.title: Football - Italian Cup / Fudbal - Italijanski kup
programme.desc: The Italian Cup creates its history since 1922. and the first edition. For the next trophy of the team from the Apennine Peninsula, they had to wait until 1936. When the competition began again and maintained each year. A somewhat curious fact is a smaller attendance of the stadium in relation to the "series of A" due to the tradition of resting the best players of the strongest Italian teams. However, everything comes down to water when the tournament is completed when the winner is guaranteed a safe place in the UEFA Europa League group. Then the interest in this competition increases abruptly. The real fan of Italian football will surely follow this competition! / Talijanski kup stvara svoju istoriju od 1922. i prvog izdanja. Za naredni trofej ekipe sa Apeninskog poluostrva morale su čekati do 1936. kada je takmičenje ponovo počelo i održavalo se svake godine. Pomalo znatiželjna činjenica je manja posjećenost stadiona u odnosu na "Seriju A" zbog tradicije odmaranja najboljih igrača najjačih talijanskih ekipa. Međutim, sve se svodi na vodu kad se turnir završi kada pobjedniku bude zajamčeno sigurno mjesto u grupi UEFA Europa lige. Tada se zanimanje za ovo takmičenje naglo povećava. Pravi navijač italijanskog fudbala sigurno će pratiti ovo takmičenje!

programme.title: FudBal - Copa Libertadores / Fudbal - Copa Libertadores
programme.desc: The "Copa Libertadores" is the annual competition founded in 1960. year and the 38 best teams of South America occur. Throughout history, the format of the competition changed, of which only the champions in their leagions have the right to perform until today when each state gives a minimum of three representatives. The most successful club with the most won titles is Argentine's giant independence. Argentina also gave the most wins of Kope. The competition has iconic status and is considered one of the suburbs of soccer events on the planet. / "Copa Libertadores" je godišnje takmičenje osnovano 1960. godine te u njemu nastupa 38 najboljih ekipa Južne Amerike. Kroz istoriju format takmičenja se mijenjao, od toga da samo prvaci u svojim liga imaju pravo nastupa pa do danas kada svaka država daje po minimalno tri predstavnika. Najuspešniji klub sa najviše osvojenih titula je argentinski velikan Indipendijente. Argentina je dala i najviše osvajača Kope. Takmičenje ima ikonski status te se smatra jednim od nauzbudljivih fudbalskih događaja na planeti.

When the competition began again and maintained each year. A somewhat curious fact is a smaller attendance of the stadium in relation to the "series of A" due to the tradition of resting the best players of the strongest Italian teams. However, everything comes down to water when the tournament is completed when the winner is guaranteed a safe place in the UEFA Europa League group. Then the interest in this competition increases abruptly. The real fan of Italian football will surely follow this competition! / Talijanski kup stvara svoju istoriju od 1922. i prvog izdanja. Za naredni trofej ekipe sa Apeninskog poluostrva morale su čekati do 1936. kada je takmičenje ponovo počelo i održavalo se svake godine. Pomalo znatiželjna činjenica je manja posjećenost stadiona u odnosu na "Seriju A" zbog tradicije odmaranja najboljih igrača najjačih talijanskih ekipa. Međutim, sve se svodi na vodu kad se turnir završi kada pobjedniku bude zajamčeno sigurno mjesto u grupi UEFA Europa lige. Tada se zanimanje za ovo takmičenje naglo povećava. Pravi navijač italijanskog fudbala sigurno će pratiti ovo takmičenje!

programme.title: Football: Europaliga / Fudbal: Europaliga
programme.desc: The second most prestigious club football competition in Europe is officially under the auspices of the European Football Federation of Uefe of 1971. The unofficial predecessor of this competition was the Cup of Fair cities that played from 1955 to 1971. Since that season, the competition has been officially called the UEFA Cup and under that name until 2009. During the years, the competition format itself has changed several times, and since the 2004/2005 season. A group phase was introduced after which elimination followed. The trophy for the winner of this competition was designed in 1972 for the UEFA Cup finals by Italian artist Bertoni, and every year he is awarded to the winner who keeps him for a year. / Drugo najprestižnije klupsko nogometno natjecanje u Evropi je službeno pod okriljem Europske nogometne federacije UEFE of 1971. godine. Neslužbeni prethodnik ovog natjecanja je bio Kup velesajamskih gradova koji se igrao od 1955. do 1971. godine. Od te sezone natjecanje se službeno zove Kup Uefa i pod tim nazivom je sve do 2009. kada je preimenovano u Uefa Evropa ligu. Tokom godina se sam format natjecanja nekoliko puta mijenjao, a od sezone 2004./2005. uvedena je grupna faza nakon koje slijede eliminacije. Sam trofej za pobjednika ovog natjecanja dizajniran je 1972. godine za finale Kupa Uefa od strane talijanskog umjetnika Bertonija i svake godine se dodjeljuje pobjedniku koji ga čuva godinu dana.

programme.title: Football - Spanish League / Fudbal - Španska liga
programme.desc: Primera or popular La Liga is the first Spanish football league. With as many as 22 conquered titles of the European Primary Champion, the Spanish Primera for years are considered the best European football league. Founded in 1929. year, the example counts 20 teams that in 38 cars are trying to collect the largest number of points. This is the most path to go to Madrid Real, while the other is the most successful Team Barcelona. With top teams of Spanish league, it adorns and extremely technical mentality of the game mostly clubs with the aim of overcoming opponents. / Primera ili popularno La Liga prva je španska fudbalska liga. Sa čak 22 osvojene titule prvaka Evrope španska Primera godinama se smatra najboljom evropskom fudbalskom ligom. Osnovana 1929. godine, Primera broji 20 ekipa koje u 38 kola sezone pokušavaju skupiti najveći broj bodova. To je najviše puta pošlo za rukom madridskom Realu dok je druga najuspješnija ekipa Barselona. Uz vrhunske ekipe špansku ligu krasi i izrazito tehnički mentalitet igre većine klubova sa ciljem za nadigravanjem protivnika.

programme.title: Football - Romania League / Fudbal - Rumunjska liga
programme.desc: Romania's first football league has a long history, the first season has been played back in 1909. year when the first title won the extinguished Olympi Bucharest today. Throughout history, the undisputed rulers of this league are Steau and Dinamo from Bucharest who took most of the title of champions. The League currently has 14 clubs and after "regular" work, where everyone plays one game at home and one in the guests, the league is divided into two parts. The first part is play off for the champion where six best clubs are participated as the rest is struggling in a special part for survival. / Prva fudbalska liga Rumunije ima dugačku istoriju, prva sezona je odigrana davne 1909. godine kada je prvu titulu osvojila danas ugašena Olimpija Bukurešt. Kroz istoriju neprikosnoveni vladari ove lige su Steaua i Dinamo iz Bukurešta koji su uzeli većinu titula šampiona. Trenutno liga broji 14 klubova i nakon "regularnog" dela, gdje svako sa svakim igra po jednu utakmicu na domaćem terenu i jednu u gostima, liga se deli na dva dijela. Prvi dio je play off za šampiona gde učestvuje šest najbolje plasiranih klubova dok se ostatak bori u posebnom delu za opstanak.

programme.title: Basketball - ABA League / Košarka - ABA liga
programme.desc: The ABA League was established by the best basketball clubs from Bosnia and Herzegovina, Montenegro, Croatia, Serbia and Slovenia. As such consists of clubs from the space of the former SFRY and representatives of Hungary, Bulgaria, Israel and the Czech Republic were still involved in it. On several occasions, it has changed the name depending on the sponsor, and today is the official name "Adriatic Basketball Association (ABA) League". The competition is played in two parts, the first part takes place by playing two games, each with each, one on the domestic and one on the away field, ie by the two-circular league system. The second part of the competition or playoffs differed from the season by season. / ABA liga je osnovana od strane najboljih košarkaških klubova iz Bosne i Hercegovine, Crne Gore, Hrvatske, Srbije i Slovenije. Kao takva sastoji se od klubova sa prostora bivše SFRJ te su u njoj još učestvovali predstavnici Mađarske, Bugarske, Izraela i Češke. U nekoliko navrata je promjenila i naziv u zavisnosti od sponzora, a danas joj je službeni naziv "Adriatic Basketball Association (ABA) League". Takmičenje se igra u dva dijela, prvi dio se odvija tako što sve ekipe igraju po dvije utakmice, svako sa svakim, jednu na domaćem i jednu na gostujućem terenu, odnosno po dvokružnom liga sistemu. Drugi dio takmičenja odnosno plej-of se razlikovao od sezone do sezone.

The second part of the competition or playoffs differed from the season by season. / ABA liga je osnovana od strane najboljih košarkaških klubova iz Bosne i Hercegovine, Crne Gore, Hrvatske, Srbije i Slovenije. Kao takva sastoji se od klubova sa prostora bivše SFRJ te su u njoj još učestvovali predstavnici Mađarske, Bugarske, Izraela i Češke. U nekoliko navrata je promjenila i naziv u zavisnosti od sponzora, a danas joj je službeni naziv "Adriatic Basketball Association (ABA) League". Takmičenje se igra u dva dijela, prvi dio se odvija tako što sve ekipe igraju po dvije utakmice, svako sa svakim, jednu na domaćem i jednu na gostujućem terenu, odnosno po dvokružnom liga sistemu. programme.title: Football: HNL / Fudbal: HNL
programme.desc: Croatian football league (HNL) was founded in 1992. year and the first historical title won Split Hajduk. Through years, the system of competition and the number of clubs changed but in recent years, today's system with 10 teams and the four-round form of the competition. Kroz godine sistem takmičenja i broj klubova se mijenjao ali poslednjih godina ustalio se današnji sistem sa 10 ekipa i četverokružnim oblikom takmičenja. Prijelazni kup namjenjen prvaku djelo je akademskog kipara Marijana Zaradića. Najviše puta osvajao ga je zagrebački Dinamo.

programme.title: Football - Superliga Serbia / Fudbal - Superliga Srbije
programme.desc: The Serbian Super League has had its premiere in the 2006/2007 season. In today's league system, there are 20 teams and functions on the two-circular principle of competition. The history of the Super League was largely marked by two large Belgrade Rivals, Partizan and Red Star. Historically, according to the number of titles, the red-white part of the city is more successful. / Srpska Superliga svoju premijeru imala je u sezoni 2006./2007. U današnjem sistemu liga broji 20 ekipa i funkcionira po dvokružnom principu takmičenja. Historiju Superlige u najvećoj su mjeri obilježila dva velika beogradska rivala, Partizan i Crvena zvezda. Historijski gledano, po broju osvojenih naslova crveno-bijeli dio grada je uspješniji.

programme.title: Football - Superliga Serbia / Fudbal - Superliga Srbije
programme.desc: The Serbian Super League has had its premiere in the 2006/2007 season. In today's league system, there are 20 teams and functions on the two-circular principle of competition. programme.title: Football: HNL / Fudbal: HNL
programme.desc: Croatian football league (HNL) was founded in 1992. year and the first historical title won Split Hajduk. Through years, the system of competition and the number of clubs changed but in recent years, today's system with 10 teams and the four-round form of the competition. The transition cup intended to champion is the work of the academic sculptor Marijana earns. He won him in Zagreb Dinamo mostly. / Hrvatska fudbalska liga (HNL) osnovana je 1992. godine i prvu istorijsku titulu je osvojio splitski Hajduk. Kroz godine sistem takmičenja i broj klubova se mijenjao ali poslednjih godina ustalio se današnji sistem sa 10 ekipa i četverokružnim oblikom takmičenja. Prijelazni kup namjenjen prvaku djelo je akademskog kipara Marijana Zaradića. Najviše puta osvajao ga je zagrebački Dinamo.

programme.title: Spartan race / Надпревара "Спартан"
programme.desc: These are exhausting competitions that combine running for endurance, strength and mental resistance. Participants are oriented through a series of obstacles designed to experience the limit on their borders. They can include climbing walls, heavy wearing objects, rope climbing, mud pits and fire. / Това са изтощителни състезания, които съчетават бягане за издръжливост, сила и психическа устойчивост. The unofficial predecessor of this competition was the Fair Cup, which was played from 1955 to 1971. Since that season, the competition has been officially called the UEFA Cup and is under this name until 2009 when it was renamed the UEFA League of Europe. During the years, the format has changed several times, and since the 2004/2005 season. A group competition was introduced after which elimination followed. The trophy for the winner of this competition was designed in 1972 for the UEFA Cup finals by Italian artist Bertoni and is awarded to the winner every year, which keeps him for a year ... / Europa League Highlights - (sport. program) Drugo najprestižnije klupsko nogometno natjecanje u Europi je službeno pod okriljem UEFA-e od 1971. godine. Neslužbeni prethodnik ovog natjecanja bio je Kup velesajamskih gradova koji se igrao od 1955. do 1971. godine. Od te sezone natjecanje se službeno zove Kup Uefa i pod tim je nazivom sve do 2009. godine kada je preimenovano u Uefa Ligu Europe. Tokom godina format se nekoliko puta mijenjao, a od sezone 2004./2005. uvedeno je natjecanje po skupinama nakon kojeg slijede eliminacije. Sam trofej za pobjednika ovog natjecanja dizajniran je 1972. za finale Kupa Uefa od strane talijanskog umjetnika Bertonija i svake se godine dodjeljuje pobjedniku koji ga čuva godinu dana...

programme.title: Lazio - Bodo/Glimt, Football, Europa League / Lazio - Bodo/glimt, Nogomet, Europa liga
programme.desc: Football: UEFA Europa League - (Sport. Program, 2024) The second most prestigious club football competition in Europe is officially under the auspices of the 1971 European Football Federation. The unofficial predecessor of this competition was the Cup of Fair cities that played from 1955 to 1971. Since that season, the competition has been officially called the UEFA Cup and under that name until 2009. When it was renamed the UEFA Europa League. Over the years, the competition format has changed several times, and since the 2004/2005 season. A group phase was introduced after which elimination followed. The trophy for the winner of this competition was designed in 1972 for the UEFA Cup finals by Italian artist Bertoni and every year is awarded to the winner who keeps him for a year ... / Football: UEFA Europa League - (sport. program, 2024) Drugo najprestižnije klupsko nogometno natjecanje u Europi je službeno pod okriljem Europske nogometne federacije UEFE of 1971. godine. Neslužbeni prethodnik ovog natjecanja je bio Kup velesajamskih gradova koji se igrao od 1955. do 1971. godine. Od te sezone natjecanje se službeno zove Kup Uefa i pod tim nazivom je sve do 2009. kada je preimenovano u Uefa Europa Ligu. Tijekom godina se sam format natjecanja nekoliko puta mijenjao, a od sezone 2004./2005. uvedena je grupna faza nakon koje slijede eliminacije. Sam trofej za pobjednika ovog natjecanja dizajniran je 1972. za finale Kupa Uefa od strane talijanskog umjetnika Bertonija i svake godine se dodjeljuje pobjedniku koji ga čuva godinu dana...

programme.desc: Football: UEFA Europa League Qualifiers - (Sport. Program, 2025) Europa League has a special charm given that this is the most massive competition under the auspices of Uefe. A large number of clubs are included in the qualifying process and the first meetings start at the end of June. This competition is specific because because of its abundance, it also gives "smaller" clubs to feel what it is like to play matches on the European scene. Given that the concentration of strong European clubs is primarily in the Champions League and the local championships in the Europa League, there are big surprises that prove that everyone knows how to play quality football today. Sljedeće godine je odigrana i prva sezona u kojoj su klubovi bili podijeljeni u četiri regije te je iz svake regije jedan klub napredovao viši rang. Uz brojne izmjene sustava natjecanja, ova liga je poznata po razvoju mnogo mladih igrača koji su se kasnije afirmirali u jakim prvoligašima kao što su Dinamo, Hajduk i Rijeka...

programme.title: Vukovar 1991 - Gorica, SuperSport HNL 2025/2026, 4th round / Vukovar 1991 - Gorica, SuperSport HNL 2025./2026., 4. kolo
programme.desc: Football - SuperSport HNL - (Sports. Program, Croatia, 2025) Follow the SuperSport Croatian Football League, the football competition of the highest rank in Croatia, which has been held since 1992 under the leadership of the Croatian Football Federation. Liga je do 2022. godine nosila naziv Prva hrvatska nogometna liga. U SuperSport HNL-u sudjeluje deset najboljih nogometnih klubova iz Hrvatske. Klub koji se okruni titulom državnoga prvaka ima priliku okušati se u 2. pretkolu UEFA Lige prvaka, dok drugoplasirani i trećeplasirani ulaze u 2. pretkolo kvalifikacija za UEFA Europsku konferencijsku ligu...

programme.title: Sesvete - BSK, SuperSport First Football League 2025/2026, 2nd round / Sesvete - BSK, SuperSport Prva nogometna liga 2025./2026., 2. kolo
programme.desc: Football - First Croatian League - (Sport. Program, 2025) The first football league is the Croatian Football Competition of the second rank, which was founded in 1991 after the breakup of Yugoslavia. Next year, the first season was played in which the clubs were divided into four regions, and a higher ranking was progressed from each region. With numerous changes to the competition system, this league is known for developing many young players who later affirmed themselves in strong first -team players such as Dinamo, Hajduk and Rijeka ... / Football - First Croatian League - (sport. program, 2025) Prva nogometna liga je hrvatsko nogometno natjecanje drugog ranga koje je osnovano je 1991. godine nakon raspada Jugoslavije. Sljedeće godine je odigrana i prva sezona u kojoj su klubovi bili podijeljeni u četiri regije te je iz svake regije jedan klub napredovao viši rang. Uz brojne izmjene sustava natjecanja, ova liga je poznata po razvoju mnogo mladih igrača koji su se kasnije afirmirali u jakim prvoligašima kao što su Dinamo, Hajduk i Rijeka...

programme.title: Vukovar 1991 - Gorica, SuperSport HNL 2025/2026, 4th round / Vukovar 1991 - Gorica, SuperSport HNL 2025./2026., 4. kolo
programme.desc: Football - SuperSport HNL - (Sports. Program, Croatia, 2025) Follow the SuperSport Croatian Football League, the football competition of the highest rank in Croatia, which has been held since 1992 under the leadership of the Croatian Football Federation. The club that is crowned with the title of national champion has the opportunity to try the 2nd round of the UEFA Champions League, while runner -up and third -ranked entering 2nd qualifying round for the UEFA European Conference League ... / Football - SuperSport HNL - (sport. program, Hrvatska, 2025) Pratite SuperSport hrvatsku nogometnu ligu, nogometno natjecanje najvišeg ranga u Hrvatskoj koje se održava od 1992. godine pod vodstvom Hrvatskoga nogometnog saveza. Liga je do 2022. godine nosila naziv Prva hrvatska nogometna liga. U SuperSport HNL-u sudjeluje deset najboljih nogometnih klubova iz Hrvatske. Klub koji se okruni titulom državnoga prvaka ima priliku okušati se u 2. pretkolu UEFA Lige prvaka, dok drugoplasirani i trećeplasirani ulaze u 2. pretkolo kvalifikacija za UEFA Europsku konferencijsku ligu...

programme.title: North near Northwest - the double Lothar / Nord bei Nordwest - Der doppelte Lothar
programme.desc: Lothar Muller (Tim Ehlert), who also likes to call "Lottchen" from friends, is a popular sales representative who is traveling a lot. But one day he doesn't come home. Hauke ​​Jacobs (Hinnerk Schonemann) and Hannah Wagner (Jana Klinge) become actual after receipt of the missing person notification. In fact, Lothar Muller's body is found on the kust - in Travemunde. He was murdered. As his wife Susanne (Johanna Christine Gehlen) and his daughter Anna (Johanna Gottng) should find out horrified, there were "Lottchen" twice: once as a father in Schwanitz - and once as a family man in Travemunde, where he has the son Finn (Karl von Klot) together with Lisa (Marie Hacke). And with it a complete second existence. / Lothar Muller (Tim Ehlert), von Freunden auch gerne mal "Lottchen" gerufen, ist ein beliebter Handelsvertreter, der viel unterwegs ist. Doch eines Tages kommt er nicht nach Hause. Hauke Jacobs (Hinnerk Schonemann) und Hannah Wagner (Jana Klinge) werden nach Eingang der Vermisstenanzeige sofort tatig. Tatsachlich wird Lothar Mullers Leiche an der Kuste gefunden - in Travemunde. Er wurde ermordet. Wie seine Frau Susanne (Johanna Christine Gehlen) und seine Tochter Anna (Johanna Gottng) entsetzt erfahren mussen, gab es "Lottchen" zweimal: einmal als Familienvater in Schwanitz - und einmal als Familienvater in Travemunde, wo er mit Lisa (Marie Hacke) den gemeinsamen Sohn Finn (Karl von Klot) hat. Und damit eine komplette zweite Existenz.

programme.title: Inas night / Inas Nacht
programme.desc: In this program, Ina Muller first welcomed actress Karoline Herfurth. She is upgraded by the sometimes unusual educational methods of her parents, her first big film love and the actual background of her fashionably glamorosic appearances. In addition, the musician Max Giesinger is discussed. He reports of his Fruhen career attempts including a crowd into a banking apprenticeship and about what you can experience as a street musician. The most most music guest of this episode is the Irish band Kingfishr, who has won many fans out of their homeland with her music inspired by Irish Folk. And alternative rock bands in Germany. 14 people deny the audience and surf with the beer lid questions. And everyone is well looked after by the pub host Ms. Muller - not related or conspired with Ina. Sounds slightly chaotic? Should it too! / In dieser Sendung begruSSt Ina Muller zunachst die Schauspielerin Karoline Herfurth. Sie erzahlt von den zum Teil ungewohnlichen Erziehungsmethoden ihrer Eltern, ihrer ersten groSSen Filmliebe und dem tatsachlichen Hintergrund ihrer modisch oft glamourosen Auftritte.Zum Gesprach hinzu kommt der Musiker Max Giesinger. Er berichtet von seinen fruhen Karriereversuchen inklusive eines Abstechers in eine Banklehre und daruber, was man als StraSSenmusiker so alles erleben kann.Erster Musikgast dieser Folge ist die irische Band Kingfishr, die mit ihrer vom irischen Folk inspirierten Musik binnen kurzester Zeit sehr viele Fans auch auSSerhalb ihrer Heimat gewonnen hat.Den Abend beschlieSSt die Band Donots, die seit mittlerweile drei Jahrzehnten zu einer der pragendsten Punk- und Alternative Rock-Bands Deutschlands gehort.Wie immer mit dabei sind auch die Herren des Wilhelmsburger Shantychors De Tampentrekker, die vor den Kneipenfenstern die Stellung halten und fur musikalische Intermezzi sorgen. 14 Personen bestreiten das Publikum und durfen mit den Bierdeckelfragen mithelfen. Und alle werden wieder bestens versorgt von der Kneipenwirtin Frau Muller - nicht verwandt oder verschwagert mit Ina. Klingt leicht chaotisch? Soll es auch!

programme.title: The Carolin Kebekus Show / Die Carolin Kebekus Show
programme.desc: The "Carolin Kebekus Show" has music in the air. Carolin challenges "No Angel" singer Lucy Diakovska for an unprecedented vocal duel. The DCK's "Duett Roulette", which is moderated by Jeannine Michaelsen, are brought together celebrities that were never otherwise met - especially not when it comes to music. Not only is there a lot of messing up here: A random generator also decides which song Carolin and Lucy will sing with which duet partners. With the selection you can have a gluck and be assigned to German music sizes - but also celebrities who have nothing with music at all. A audience voting in the studio ultimately determines who won: Who will be duet roulette champion 2025? / Bei der "Carolin Kebekus Show" liegt Musik in der Luft. Carolin fordert "No Angel"-Sangerin Lucy Diakovska zu einem nie dagewesenen Gesangs-Duell heraus. programme.title: Commissario Laurenti - the dead from the Karst / Commissario Laurenti - Die Toten vom Karst
programme.desc: The Triester Commissario Laurenti (Henry Hubchen) is in a private crisis: his wife Laura (Barbara Rudnik), he suspects, has a lover with whom she apparently spent a romantic week by the sea; His son Marco (Sergej Moya) goes on the street with a left -wing group on every occasion against the "brutal police state". In this situation, Laurenti is confronted with a murder case that was confused: During a night bomb attack on her house, the delicatessen Manlio Gubian and his pregnant wife are killed. There does not seem to be a motif for the precisely planned bloody deed. Antonio Gubian (Gotz George), the father of the murdered, also has no explanation for the attack. Commissario Laurenti stands in front of a council. At the same time, a man of her crew over on board and drowns on the high seas goes to a mysterious night-and-fog campaign by the old fisherman Ugo Marasi (Hermann Beyer) and his daughter Nicoletta (Anne Bennent). When the old Marasi is brutally murdered shortly afterwards, there seems to be no connection with the Gubian case. However, after Marasis widow Bruna (Hannelore Hoger) has publicly referred to the old Gubian as the murder of her husband, the puzzle parts are always compiled for Commissario Laurenti: the Croatian Gubian and the Marasi family have connected an ancient hoston since Gubian was supposed to be responsible for the murder of Marasi's sister. At the same time, however, Laurenti finds out that the opaque Nicoletta Marasi smuggled with the Gubian living in his homeland despite this hostility over the sea path cocaine and used her father as a middle man. Did she know about the murder planning? It almost seems when there is a new, dark secret of the two uncolently connected families behind every corner. Now it is to Laurenti to disguise the thread of this braid of drug trafficking and family gang, love and blood revenge ... / Der Triester Commissario Laurenti (Henry Hubchen) steckt in einer privaten Krise: Seine Frau Laura (Barbara Rudnik), so vermutet er, hat einen Liebhaber, mit dem sie offenbar eine romantische Woche am Meer verlebt; sein Sohn Marco (Sergej Moya) geht mit einer linken Gruppierung bei jeder Gelegenheit gegen den "brutalen Polizeistaat" auf die StraSSe. In dieser Situation wird Laurenti mit einem uberaus vertrackten Mordfall konfrontiert: Bei einem nachtlichen Bombenanschlag auf ihr Haus kommen der Feinkosthandler Manlio Gubian und dessen schwangere Ehefrau ums Leben. Ein Motiv fur die genau geplante Bluttat scheint es nicht zu geben. Auch Antonio Gubian (Gotz George), der Vater des Ermordeten, hat keine Erklarung fur das Attentat. Commissario Laurenti steht vor einem Ratsel. Zur gleichen Zeit geht bei einer mysteriosen Nacht-und-Nebel-Aktion des alten Fischers Ugo Marasi (Hermann Beyer) und dessen Tochter Nicoletta (Anne Bennent) auf hoher See ein Mann ihrer Besatzung uber Bord und ertrinkt. Als kurz darauf der alte Marasi brutal ermordet aufgefunden wird, scheint es zunachst keinen Zusammenhang mit dem Fall Gubian zu geben. Nachdem jedoch Marasis Witwe Bruna (Hannelore Hoger) den alten Gubian offentlich als Morder ihres Mannes bezeichnet, setzen sich fur Commissario Laurenti die Puzzle-Teile allmahlich zusammen: Den Kroaten Gubian und die Marasi-Familie verbindet eine uralte Feindschaft, seit Gubian vor vielen Jahren angeblich fur die Ermordung von Marasis Schwester verantwortlich war. Zugleich aber findet Laurenti heraus, dass die undurchsichtige Nicoletta Marasi mit dem in seiner Heimat lebenden Gubian trotz dieser Feindschaft uber den Seeweg Kokain schmuggelt und ihren Vater dabei als Mittelsmann benutzte. Wusste sie womoglich von den Mordplanen? Fast scheint es, als kame hinter jeder Ecke ein neues, dunkles Geheimnis der beiden unheilvoll verbundenen Familien zum Vorschein. Nun ist es an Laurenti, die Faden dieses Geflechts aus Drogenhandel und Familienbande, Liebe und Blutrache zu entwirren ...

programme.title: At the scene / Am Schauplatz
programme.sub-title: Meisterwerk - von der Freude an der Handarbeit
programme.desc: Most objects that surround us in everyday life are industrially manufactured. Manual work is expensive in almost every context and you try to avoid them. At the same time, an increasing number of young people discovered working with their hand and learning craftsmanship as a source of Gluck and Satisfaction. 18 years ago, at the scene reporter Robert Gordon, the apprentice of shoemakers Georg Maier met in the workshop of his master in Lower Easter Empire. The young man hadn't been happily with the school, but how to make shoes was interested, and he still finds it exciting. Uben to uben over a thousands of hours does not have a deterrent to people like Georg Maier. Experience yourself as competent every time a master's stucco often pays more than a high income. For many people, this kind of satisfaction is hard to achieve in their everyday work. Passionate craftsmen are even willing to do without collateral that have already been achieved. Bernhard Dellinger, a graduate engineer and young family man, has found a youth wish and gave up his well-paid job in industry. He wants to become a self -made carpenter. Just like the former web designer Marie, with whom he will compete in autumn. Art and craft the violin builders Kerstin Hoffmann and Claudia Rook combine, who build their instruments in a common workshop and the glassmaker Robert Comploj.fur visits Robert Gordon different workshops and tries to achieve the fascination of craft. / Die meisten Gegenstande, die uns im Alltag umgeben, sind industriell gefertigt. Handarbeit ist in fast jedem Zusammenhang teuer und man versucht sie zu vermeiden. Zugleich entdeckt eine zunehmende Anzahl junger Menschen die Arbeit mit der Hand und das Erlernen handwerklicher Kompetenzen als Quelle von Gluck und Zufriedenheit.Vor 18 Jahren hat Am Schauplatz-Reporter Robert Gordon den Schuhmacherlehrling Georg Maier in der Werkstatt seines Meisters in Niederosterreich kennen gelernt. Mit der Schule war der junge Mann nicht glucklich gewesen, aber wie man Schuhe macht, das hat ihn interessiert, und er findet das immer noch spannend. Über tausendende Stunden Handgriffe zu uben, wirkt fur Menschen wie Georg Maier nicht abschreckend. Sich selbst jedes Mal wieder als kompetent zu erleben, wenn ein Meisterstuck fertig ist, zahlt oft mehr als ein hohes Einkommen.Fur viele Menschen ist diese Art Befriedigung in ihrem Arbeitsalltag kaum zu erreichen. Dafur sind leidenschaftliche Handwerker sogar bereit, auf bereits erreichte Sicherheiten zu verzichten. Bernhard Dellinger, Diplomingenieur und junger Familienvater, hat sich einen Jugend-Wunsch erfullt und seinen gut bezahlten Job in der Industrie aufgegeben. Er will selbstandiger Tischlermeister werden. So wie die ehemalige Webdesignerin Marie, mit der er im Herbst zur Meisterprufung antreten wird.Kunst und Handwerk vereinen die Geigenbauerinnen Kerstin Hoffmann und Claudia Rook, die ihre Instrumente in einer gemeinsamen Werkstatt bauen und der Glasmacher Robert Comploj.Fur seine aktuelle Reportage besucht Robert Gordon unterschiedliche Werkstatten und versucht die Faszination Handwerk zu ergrunden.

programme.desc: A race for the latest development of artificial intelligence (AI) broke out in the digital world. programme.title: Language diversity in the Alpine Adria room / Sprachenvielfalt im Alpen-Adria-Raum
programme.desc: Using the example of the neighboring regions of Karnten, Friuli-Julian Veneto and Slovenia, production from the ORF State Studio Karnten is on the trail of language. The focus is on the different experiences of people who live at the intersection of three cultures and the advantage of the nearby to the neighbors. Regardless of their linguistic and cultural roots, for many of them, multilingualism. The language combines us together, language moves, language also suffer new possibilities in the limitless world of work. The language of love brings some to gain a foothold in his or her "new home" and a family. But as the saying goes: Not only "the people come through talking" - they are also experiences in different areas that make state and cultural borders disappear and make the common habitat in the heart of Europe worth living. The language of memories, for example, makes the vacation on the sea experienced as a child unforgettable and the language of customs apparently "incidentally" enables "by the way". The Alpen-Adria room is rich in common history-it has not always been peaceful and current herd of crisis in other countries let the language of non-violence for a "peace region Alpen-Adria" propagated by scientists. From a culinary point of view, the Alpine Adria area is also characterized by different influences. So love for the neighboring regions for many also goes through the stomach. And then there were the "universal language" par excellence, the language of music, which often moves and connects people without words over the borders. / Am Beispiel der Nachbarregionen Karnten, Friaul-Julisch Venetien und Slowenien ist die Produktion aus dem ORF Landesstudio Karnten der Sprache auf der Spur. Im Mittelpunkt stehen die unterschiedlichen Erfahrungen von Menschen, die am Schnittpunkt dreier Kulturen leben und die Vorzuge der Nahe zu den Nachbarn zu schatzen wissen. Unabhangig von ihren sprachlichen und kulturellen Wurzeln gehort fur viele von ihnen Mehrsprachigkeit zum Alltag. Die Sprache verbindet uns miteinander, Sprache bewegt, Sprache eroffnet auch neue Moglichkeiten in der grenzenlosen Arbeitswelt. Die Sprache der Liebe bringt so manchen dazu, in seiner oder ihrer "neuen Heimat" FuSS zu fassen und eine Familie zu grunden. Doch wie heiSSt es so schon: nicht nur "durchs Reden kommen die Leut zsam" - es sind auch Erlebnisse in unterschiedlichen Bereichen, die Staats- und Kulturgrenzen verschwinden lassen und den gemeinsamen Lebensraum im Herzen Europas lebenswert machen. Die Sprache der Erinnerungen etwa macht den als Kind erlebten Urlaub am Meer unvergesslich und die Sprache des Brauchtums ermoglicht Kulturvermittlung scheinbar "nebenbei". Der Alpen-Adria-Raum ist reich an gemeinsamer Geschichte - friedlich ist es nicht immer zugegangen und aktuelle Krisenherde in anderen Landern lassen die Sprache der Gewaltfreiheit fur eine von Wissenschaftern propagierten "Friedensregion Alpen-Adria" in den Fokus rucken. Und dann ware da noch die "Universalsprache" schlechthin, die Sprache der Musik, die die Menschen oft auch ohne Worte uber die Grenzen hinweg bewegt und verbindet.

programme.title: At the scene / Am Schauplatz
programme.sub-title: Meisterwerk - von der Freude an der Handarbeit
programme.desc: Most objects that surround us in everyday life are industrially manufactured. Manual work is expensive in almost every context and you try to avoid them. At the same time, an increasing number of young people discovered working with their hand and learning craftsmanship as a source of Gluck and Satisfaction. 18 years ago, at the scene reporter Robert Gordon, the apprentice of shoemakers Georg Maier met in the workshop of his master in Lower Easter Empire. The young man hadn't been happily with the school, but how to make shoes was interested, and he still finds it exciting. Uben to uben over a thousands of hours does not have a deterrent to people like Georg Maier. Experience yourself as competent every time a master's stucco often pays more than a high income. For many people, this kind of satisfaction is hard to achieve in their everyday work. Passionate craftsmen are even willing to do without collateral that have already been achieved. Bernhard Dellinger, a graduate engineer and young family man, has found a youth wish and gave up his well-paid job in industry. He wants to become a self -made carpenter. Just like the former web designer Marie, with whom he will compete in autumn. Art and craft the violin builders Kerstin Hoffmann and Claudia Rook combine, who build their instruments in a common workshop and the glassmaker Robert Comploj.fur visits Robert Gordon different workshops and tries to achieve the fascination of craft. / Die meisten Gegenstande, die uns im Alltag umgeben, sind industriell gefertigt. Handarbeit ist in fast jedem Zusammenhang teuer und man versucht sie zu vermeiden. Zugleich entdeckt eine zunehmende Anzahl junger Menschen die Arbeit mit der Hand und das Erlernen handwerklicher Kompetenzen als Quelle von Gluck und Zufriedenheit.Vor 18 Jahren hat Am Schauplatz-Reporter Robert Gordon den Schuhmacherlehrling Georg Maier in der Werkstatt seines Meisters in Niederosterreich kennen gelernt. Mit der Schule war der junge Mann nicht glucklich gewesen, aber wie man Schuhe macht, das hat ihn interessiert, und er findet das immer noch spannend. Über tausendende Stunden Handgriffe zu uben, wirkt fur Menschen wie Georg Maier nicht abschreckend. Sich selbst jedes Mal wieder als kompetent zu erleben, wenn ein Meisterstuck fertig ist, zahlt oft mehr als ein hohes Einkommen.Fur viele Menschen ist diese Art Befriedigung in ihrem Arbeitsalltag kaum zu erreichen. Dafur sind leidenschaftliche Handwerker sogar bereit, auf bereits erreichte Sicherheiten zu verzichten. programme.desc: Using the example of the neighboring regions of Karnten, Friuli-Julian Veneto and Slovenia, production from the ORF State Studio Karnten is on the trail of language. The language of memories, for example, makes the vacation on the sea experienced as a child unforgettable and the language of customs apparently "incidentally" enables "by the way". The Alpen-Adria room is rich in common history-it has not always been peaceful and current herd of crisis in other countries let the language of non-violence for a "peace region Alpen-Adria" propagated by scientists. From a culinary point of view, the Alpine Adria area is also characterized by different influences. So love for the neighboring regions for many also goes through the stomach. And then there were the "universal language" par excellence, the language of music, which often moves and connects people without words over the borders. / Am Beispiel der Nachbarregionen Karnten, Friaul-Julisch Venetien und Slowenien ist die Produktion aus dem ORF Landesstudio Karnten der Sprache auf der Spur. Im Mittelpunkt stehen die unterschiedlichen Erfahrungen von Menschen, die am Schnittpunkt dreier Kulturen leben und die Vorzuge der Nahe zu den Nachbarn zu schatzen wissen. Unabhangig von ihren sprachlichen und kulturellen Wurzeln gehort fur viele von ihnen Mehrsprachigkeit zum Alltag. Die Sprache verbindet uns miteinander, Sprache bewegt, Sprache eroffnet auch neue Moglichkeiten in der grenzenlosen Arbeitswelt. Die Sprache der Liebe bringt so manchen dazu, in seiner oder ihrer "neuen Heimat" FuSS zu fassen und eine Familie zu grunden. Doch wie heiSSt es so schon: nicht nur "durchs Reden kommen die Leut zsam" - es sind auch Erlebnisse in unterschiedlichen Bereichen, die Staats- und Kulturgrenzen verschwinden lassen und den gemeinsamen Lebensraum im Herzen Europas lebenswert machen. Die Sprache der Erinnerungen etwa macht den als Kind erlebten Urlaub am Meer unvergesslich und die Sprache des Brauchtums ermoglicht Kulturvermittlung scheinbar "nebenbei". Der Alpen-Adria-Raum ist reich an gemeinsamer Geschichte - friedlich ist es nicht immer zugegangen und aktuelle Krisenherde in anderen Landern lassen die Sprache der Gewaltfreiheit fur eine von Wissenschaftern propagierten "Friedensregion Alpen-Adria" in den Fokus rucken. Und dann ware da noch die "Universalsprache" schlechthin, die Sprache der Musik, die die Menschen oft auch ohne Worte uber die Grenzen hinweg bewegt und verbindet.

programme.title: Land of the mountains / Land der Berge
programme.sub-title: Das magische Maggiatal: Klare Bergseen und majestatische Gipfel
programme.desc: Hans Jochler is traveling in the magical Maggiatal in Switzerland in this visual "Land of Mountain" production. The mixture of alpine beautiful and Mediterranean flair makes the Maggiatal a unique background place. The idyllic places, in a wonderful location between mountains and water, have attracted artists since the 20th century. In Ascona, the climatic health resort of Ascona with its inviting lake promenade you can experience the messenger of the spring up close. The impressive "Holy Mountain" Madonna del Sasso, a place of pilgrimage on a rock lead with a breathtaking view over the lake, allows an insight behind its historical and spiritual walls. Apart from the moon banks of the Lago Maggiore, the wild, beautiful Alps reveals itself, which offer a unique setting for small towns such as Bignasco. From historical straw roofers in Onsernone to modern architectural wonders in Mogno - "Land of the Mountains" immerse yourself in the diverse culture and history of the Maggiatal and portrays one of the most beautiful regions in Switzerland. / In dieser bildgewaltigen "Land der Berge"-Produktion ist Hans Jochler im magischen Maggiatal in der Schweiz unterwegs. Die Mischung aus alpiner Schonheit und mediterranem Flair macht das Maggiatal zu einem einzigartigen Ruckzugsort. Die idyllischen Orte, in herrlicher Lage zwischen Bergen und Wasser, ziehen seit dem 20. Jahrhundert Kunstlerinnen und Kunstler an.Im Luftkurort Ascona mit seiner einladenden Seepromenade kann man die Boten des Fruhlings hautnah miterleben. Der beeindruckende "heilige Berg" Madonna del Sasso, ein Wallfahrtsort auf einem Felsvorsprung mit atemberaubendem Blick uber den See, erlaubt Einblicke hinter seine geschichtstrachtigen und spirituellen Mauern. Abseits der mondanen Ufer des Lago Maggiore offenbart sich die wilde Schonheit der Tessiner Alpen, die eine einzigartige Kulisse fur kleine Ortschaften wie Bignasco bieten. Von historischen Strohdachern in Onsernone bis zu modernen Architekturwundern in Mogno - "Land der Berge" taucht ein in die vielfaltige Kultur und Geschichte des Maggiatals und portraitiert eine der schonsten Regionen der Schweiz.

programme.title: Land of the mountains / Land der Berge
programme.desc: Kuhn built, on a rock nose in the tranquil Allgau, the stone dream of Ludwig II - the Neuschwanstein Castle. Between illusionist wall paintings, gold -based fabrics and all sorts of objects, each one of which represents a real gem, the lock is decorated with different leitmotifs: the swan as a heraldic animal and a Christian symbol of purity can be found in many corners and angles. Although the Marchenwelt Neuschwanstein was probably able to enchant its visitors for days with their pomp and splendor, the trip continues; Passing the Plansee, which acts like a matt grun mirror for the summit over the bogged summit, to the goal: the Wilde Karwendelgebirge. More than 340 sources arise from the local landscape there - including the Isar, which is probably known to many as a Bavarian, although their origin is in Tyrol. In this "Land of the Mountains" production, the filmmaker Hans Jochler runs through the splendid world of locksmith, residences and estates, without losing the fascinating treasures of nature. / Kuhn errichtet, auf einer Felsnase im beschaulichen Allgau steht der Stein gewordene Traum Konig Ludwigs II. - das Schloss Neuschwanstein. Zwischen illusionistischen Wandmalereien, golddurchwirkten Stoffen und allerlei Gegenstanden, von denen jeder Einzelne ein wahres Kleinod darstellt, ist das Schloss mit verschiedenen Leitmotiven verziert: So ist der Schwan als Wappentier und christliches Symbol der Reinheit in vielen Ecken und Winkeln wiederzufinden. Obgleich die Marchenwelt Neuschwansteins ihre BesucherInnen wohl auch tagelang mit ihrem Pomp und Prunk bezaubern konnte, fuhrt die Reise weiter; vorbei am Plansee, der wie ein mattgruner Spiegel fur die ihn umsaumenden Gipfel wirkt, bis zum Ziel: das wilde Karwendelgebirge. Mehr als 340 Quellen entspringen der dortigen, urtumlichen Landschaft - so auch die Isar, die vielen wohl eher als Bayerin bekannt ist, obgleich ihr Ursprung in Tirol liegt. In dieser "Land der Berge"-Produktion fuhrt der Filmemacher Hans Jochler durch die prachtige Welt der Schlosser, Residenzen und Anwesen, ohne dabei das Staunen fur die faszinierenden Kostbarkeiten der Natur zu verlieren.

programme.desc: The year 1968 was characterized by political upheaval: worldwide students and burger lawyers went on the street, Martin Luther King was murdered, and the Prague FRUHLING brutally depressed. During this time, Hans Werner Henzes Oratorium was supposed to be the flow of the Medusa - but protests and police operation made the premiere a political event. Ernst Schnabel's text gives the survivors a voice and refers to social misstance. Since its scandal -faithful premiere, the flow of the Medusa has been a symbol of artistic resistance - and has lost none of its currentity to this day. / Das Jahr 1968 war gepragt von politischen Umbruchen: Weltweit gingen Studierende und Burgerrechtler auf die StraSSe, Martin Luther King wurde ermordet, und der Prager Fruhling brutal niedergeschlagen. In dieser Zeit sollte in Hamburg Hans Werner Henzes Oratorium Das FloSS der Medusa uraufgefuhrt werden - doch Proteste und Polizeieinsatz machten die Premiere selbst zum politischen Ereignis.Henzes Werk zahlt zu den bedeutendsten politischen Musikstucken des 20. Jahrhunderts. Inspiriert von Gericaults Gemalde erzahlt es die wahre Geschichte des Schiffbruchs der franzosischen Fregatte Meduse von 1816, bei dem 154 Menschen auf einem FloSS dem Meer uberlassen wurden, wahrend sich die Verantwortlichen retteten.Mit eindringlicher Musik klagt Henze soziale Ungerechtigkeit und Machtmissbrauch an. Der Text von Ernst Schnabel gibt den Überlebenden eine Stimme und verweist auf gesellschaftliche Missstande. Seit seiner skandaltrachtigen Urauffuhrung gilt Das FloSS der Medusa als Symbol kunstlerischen Widerstands - und hat bis heute nichts von seiner Aktualitat verloren.

programme.title: Austria - the whole story / Österreich - Die ganze Geschichte
programme.desc: Whether eating, in body care, in medicine - our life today is based on hygiene. But historically, hygiene is quite a novelty. R: Alexander Frohner / Ob beim Essen, in der Korperpflege, in der Medizin - unser heutiges Leben fuSSt auf der Hygiene. Doch die Hygiene ist historisch gesehen ein ziemliches Novum. From the Gmundnerberghaus you have the earliest view of the Traunsee. Then Harry takes the cable car on the Feuerkogel. Fire was depressed here thousands of years ago for the summer solstice, hence the name. The Kranabeth Hutte is located a few minutes' walk from the Feuerkogel cable car mountain station. The former protective hut was taken over by two Hutten hosts. One takes care of the music and for the Schmah, the other pushing the kitchen ... / Harry Prunster begruSSt zur letzten Folge dieses Sommers.Gmunden, die lebhafte Stadt mit sudlichem Charme, hat seit der Ernennung zur Kurstadt (1862) nichts von ihrer Anziehungskraft verloren. Ihre einmalige Lage am Ufer des Traunsees, umgeben von Bergen, bietet zusammen mit ihrer kulturellen Vergangenheit ein besonderes Flair. Die Wanderschuhe angezogen, und schon gehts fur Harry los auf den Gmundnerberg. Vom Gmundnerberghaus hat man den schonsten Blick auf den Traunsee. Dann nimmt Harry die Seilbahn auf den Feuerkogel. Vor Tausenden von Jahren wurden hier zur Sommersonnenwende Feuer entzundet, daher der Name. Wenige Gehminuten von der Bergstation Feuerkogelseilbahn entfernt, befindet sich die Kranabeth Hutte. Die ehemalige Schutzhutte wurde von zwei Huttenwirten ubernommen. Der eine sorgt fur die Musik und fur den Schmah, der andere schupft die Kuche ...

In front of the breathtaking backdrop of the Caribbean, the show promises a gripping spectacle that combines the tension of high-carate sports reality with first-class entertainment. The participants get in a number of excessive obstacle courses, which test their body and emotional strong testing - produces in the Dominican Republic. In the spotlight: the challenging competition and the great emotions of the participants, all of whom let participate in their adventures. / EXATLON Germany - wer stellt sich dem ultimativen Hartetest in der Karibik? Das global erfolgreiche Sport-Reality-Format EXATLON kommt nach Deutschland - und lauft ab sofort auf SPORT1 in der Primetime. EXATLON ist das energiegeladene Sport-Reality-Format, das weltweit bereits zahlreiche Zuschauer in seinen Bann gezogen hat. Vor der atemberaubenden Kulisse der Karibik verspricht die Show ein packendes Spektakel, das die Spannung hochkaratiger Sport-Reality mit erstklassiger Unterhaltung verknupft. SPORT1, bekannt fur hochklassige Sport-Inhalte, bringt nun EXATLON Germany auf den Bildschirm und verbindet dabei intensive korperliche Herausforderungen Jochen Stutzky moderiert. Zahlreiche Athleten und Prominente treffen aufeinander, um in zwei Teams beim hartesten Wettkampf der Welt an ihre Grenzen zu gehen. Die Teilnehmer kampfen in einer Reihe von aufreibenden Hindernisparcours, die ihre korperliche und emotionale Starke austesten - produziert in der Dominikanischen Republik. Im Rampenlicht: Der herausfordernde Wettbewerb und die groSSen Emotionen der Teilnehmerinnen und Teilnehmer, die alle an ihren Abenteuern teilhaben lassen.

The two brother Randy and Wayne Cohen are mainly the owners of the "Royal Pawn Shop", and their children are also involved in Elys and Nate. The family members do not always agree when it comes to the best deals. The Cohens' customers could not be more different: from the Sussen children's gartner to unscrupulous managers, everything is included. / In der neuen Doku-Serie "Hardcore Pawn Chicago" dreht sich alles um den Alltag der wohlhabenden Familie Cohen, die eines der groSSten und altesten Pfandleihhauser in "Windy City" besitzen. Eigentumer des "Royal Pawn Shop" sind vor allem die beiden Bruder Randy und Wayne Cohen, daruber hinaus sind auch deren Kinder Elyse und Nate in die Geschafte involviert. Die Familienmitglieder sind sich nicht immer einig, wenn es um die besten Deals geht. Die Kundschaft der Cohens konnte nicht unterschiedlicher sein: Von der suSSen Kindergartnerin bis zum skrupellosen Manager ist alles dabei.

programme.title: Container Wars / Container Wars
programme.desc: From now on, it is also made in the port: In the new series "Container Wars", the content of large ship containers from all over the world comes under the hammer. In this rapid business, however, not only a thick wallet is needed, but also a good eye and iron nerves to be successful. The auctioners only have a few minutes to get a first impression of the container. Therefore, you only know after the auction whether it was worth it or not. John Kunkle, who always has one or the other saying ready. The Israeli entrepreneur duo Shlomi and Uzi, the charming Sudlander Jason, the two Californians Ty and Mo, the experienced Matthew and the former Schonheitkonigin Deana, who wants to assert himself in the manner, are entitled to the bidders. / Ab sofort werden auch im Hafen Geschafte gemacht: In der neuen Serie "Container Wars" kommt der Inhalt von groSSen Schiffscontainern aus der ganzen Welt unter den Hammer. In diesem rasanten Business braucht es allerdings nicht nur einen dicken Geldbeutel, sondern auch ein gutes Auge und eiserne Nerven, um Erfolg zu haben. Den Auktionaren bleiben nur wenige Minuten, um sich einen ersten Eindruck vom Inhalt der Container zu verschaffen. Daher weiSS man auch erst nach der Versteigerung, ob sich das Geschaft gelohnt hat oder nicht. Die Auktionen ubernimmt die lokale Beruhmtheit John Kunkle, der immer den einen oder anderen Spruch parat hat. Zu den Bietern gehoren das israelische Unternehmer-Duo Shlomi und Uzi, der charmante Sudlander Jason, die beiden Kalifornier Ty und Mo, der erfahrene Matthew und die ehemalige Schonheitskonigin Deana, die sich in der Mannerdomane behaupten will.

programme.title: Highway Cops / Highway Cops
programme.desc: In the documentary format "Highway Cops", everything revolves around the almost 11,000 kilometer-long state of Highways New Zealand. In the case of sheet metal and personal injury, the accident bodies in the state of Victoria and the meticulous determination of the causes are vital. / Beim Dokutainment-Format "Highway Cops" dreht sich alles um Unfalle auf den fast 11.000 Kilometer langen State Highways Neuseelands. Bei Blech- und Personenschaden sind Absicherung der Unfallstellen im Bundesstaat Victoria und die akribische Ermittlung der Ursachen lebenswichtig.

programme.title: Caretaker Krause - order must be / Hausmeister Krause - Ordnung muss sein
programme.desc: In the comedy series "Caretaker Krause", everything revolves around Dieter Krause (played by Tom Gerhardt), who would like to turn things to his advantage, but steps in all kinds of fat and in the "Kalker Weg 5" residential complex in Koln-Kalk has to take care of order. Unfortunately, he and some tenants have a completely different idea of ​​what that should mean. There is also some turbulence for the family man. The episode is called "Tommie is burned". / In der Comedy-Serie "Hausmeister Krause" dreht sich alles um Dieter Krause (gespielt von Tom Gerhardt), der die Dinge am liebsten zu seinem Vorteil drehen mochte, dabei aber in allerlei Fettnapfchen tritt und in der Wohnanlage "Kalker Weg 5" in Koln-Kalk alle Hande voll zu tun hat fur Ordnung zu sorgen. Leider haben er und einige Mieter eine ganz andere Vorstellung davon, was das bedeuten soll. Auch familiar gibt es einige Turbulenzen fur den Familienvater. die Episode heiSSt "Tommie wird verheizt".

programme.title: Darts Party / Darts Party
programme.desc: "Darts Party" goes into the 3rd round! Target disc free for thrill, action and lots of fun! In the third season of "Darts Party", the participants got to the big series finale in a tournament of several weeks. In over 20 fast -paced episodes, it is not just about the perfect throwing gate - but around the way there: whether on rotating platforms, slippery soil or with flying barriers - if you want to hit the board, you first have to overcome the obstacles. Prazision, concentration and athletics are in demand - and take care of spectacular scenes and best entertainment. But only one of them makes it into the big final. More show. More action. More darts! Now turn on and cheer - at the new season Darts Party! / "Darts Party" geht in die 3. Runde! Zielscheibe frei fur Nervenkitzel, Action und jede Menge SpaSS! In der dritten Staffel von "Darts Party" kampfen die Teilnehmenden in einem mehrwochigen Turnier um den Einzug ins groSSe Serienfinale. In uber 20 temporeichen Episoden gehts nicht nur ums perfekte Wurfgefuhl - sondern um den Weg dorthin: Ob auf drehenden Plattformen, glitschigen Boden oder mit fliegenden Barrieren - wer das Board treffen will, muss erstmal die Hindernisse uberwinden. Prazision, Konzentration und Athletik sind gefragt - und sorgen fur spektakulare Szenen und beste Unterhaltung.Jede Woche gipfelt im nervenaufreibenden Wochenfinale, in dem sich die vier Tagessieger duellieren. Doch nur eine*r von ihnen schafft es ins groSSe Finale.Mehr Show. Mehr Action. Mehr Darts!Jetzt einschalten und mitfiebern - bei der neuen Staffel Darts Party!

programme.title: Triebwerk - the automail magazine with Tim Schrick / Triebwerk - Das Automagazin mit Tim Schrick
programme.desc: In the new format "engine" with motor expert and racing driver Tim Schrick, everything is about the car. In addition to contributions, news and compact reports on current vehicles, the Automagazin produced by EVO 7 GmbH also has exciting youngtimer stories with Alex Wesselsky. "Petrolhead" Schrick always goes to different road trips for the show, but a lot also takes place on Bilster Berg: the demanding race track is his home base and how created for real hard tests. "Triebwerk- The Automagazin with Tim Schrick" is pretended by Climair, the manufacturer of high-quality car accessories such as car sun protection and wind and rainproof. With this format, the moderator celebrates its comeback on Sport1. Before that, Tim made a name for himself with a lot of know-how, wit and charm on Sport1 or previously in the DSF, among other things through cult programs such as "Turbo" and "DSF Motor". Alex Wesselsky was also used for Sport1 with the "Order Auto" format. / Im neuen Format "Triebwerk" mit Motorexperte und Rennfahrer Tim Schrick dreht sich alles rund ums Auto. Neben Beitragen, News und kompakten Reportagen zu aktuellen Fahrzeugen hat das von der EVO 7 GmbH produzierte Automagazin auch spannende Youngtimer-Stories mit Alex Wesselsky zu bieten. "Petrolhead" Schrick begibt sich fur die Sendung immer wieder auf verschiedene Roadtrips, vieles spielt sich aber auch am Bilster Berg ab: Die anspruchsvolle Rennstrecke ist seine Homebase und wie geschaffen fur echte Hartetests. "Triebwerk - Das Automagazin mit Tim Schrick" wird von ClimAir, dem Hersteller von hochwertigem Autozubehor wie Pkw-Sonnenschutz und Wind- and Regenabweisern, prasentiert. Mit diesem Format feiert der Moderator sein Comeback auf SPORT1. Davor machte Tim sich mit jeder Menge Knowhow, Witz und Charme auf SPORT1 bzw. zuvor im DSF bereits unter anderem durch Kultsendungen wie "TURBO" und "DSF Motor" einen Namen beim TV-Publikum. Auch Alex Wesselsky war mit dem Format "Auftrag Auto" ebenfalls schon fur SPORT1 im Einsatz.

programme.title: Martial Sport - MMA: PFL World Tournament 10 Finals Fabian Edwards Vs Dalton Rosta / Borilački sport - MMA: PFL World Tournament 10 Finals Fabian Edwards vs Dalton Rosta
programme.desc: The term Mixed Martial Arts was first documented in 1993. year by the American television critics of Hauard Rozenberg. He called this sport by doing this sport at the Ultimate Fighting Championship Tournament in martial arts. After that sporting event, that term slowly became accepted in the world. The MMA has three phases of struggles that divide legs, struggle in the kid and fight in the partner. Each struggle and round begins on their feet and then fighters most often use boxing techniques, kikboxes and Thai boxes. In the clinch, the most common boxes and Thai boxing techniques are used while the pattern is used on the partner, Juda, Sambuba and Juda Jicu. / Termin mixed martial arts se prvi put dokumentovano koristio 1993. godine od strane američkog televizijskog kritičara Hauarda Rozenberga. On je tako nazvao ovaj sport radeći osvrt na Ultimate Fighting Championship turnir u borilačkim veštinama. Nakon tog sportskog događaja taj termin je polako postao prihvaćen u svetu. MMA ima tri faze borbe koje se dele na borbu nogama, borba u klinču i borba u parteru. Svaka borba i runda počinje na nogama i tada borci najčešće koriste tehnike boksa, kikboksa i tajlandskog boksa. U klinču su najčešće tehnike boksa i tajlandskog boksa dok na parteru se koristi znanje rvanja, džuda, sambe i džiju džicua.

Only the competition is divided into two divisions, western and east and after regular part, the Pleffeus is played for the Stanley Cup trophy. / Natonal Hockey League je najprestižnije klupsko hokejaško takmičenje na svetu koje datira još iz 1917. godine kada je takmičenje formirano i funkcionisalo je sa još dve severnoameričke hokejšake asocijacije. Od 1926. NHL postaje glavna i najznačajnija hokejaška asocijacija i samim time takmičenje u Severnoj Americi. Samo takmičenje je podeljeno u dve divizije, zapadnu i istočnu te se nakon regularnog dela igra plejof za trofej Stenli kupa.

programme.title: Basketball - ABA League: Cibona - Partizan / Košarka - ABA liga: Cibona - Partizan
programme.desc: The ABA League was established by the best basketball clubs from Bosnia and Herzegovina, Montenegro, Croatia, Serbia and Slovenia. As such consists of clubs from the space of the former SFRY and representatives of Hungary, Bulgaria, Israel and the Czech Republic were still involved in it. On several occasions, it also changed the name depending on the sponsor, and today is the official name of Adriatic Basketball Association (ABA) League. The competition is played in two parts, the first part takes place by playing two games, each, with each, one on the domestic terrain and one on the guest field, ie along the two-circular league system. The second part of the competition or playoff differs from season to season. / ABA liga je osnovana od strane najboljih košarkaških klubova iz Bosne i Hercegovine, Crne Gore, Hrvatske, Srbije i Slovenije. Kao takva sastoji se od klubova sa prostora bivše SFRJ te su u njoj još učestvovali predstavnici Mađarske, Bugarske, Izraela i Češke. U nekoliko navrata je menjala i naziv u zavisnosti od sponzora, a danas joj je službeni naziv Adriatic Basketball Association (ABA) League. Takmičenje se igra u dva dela, prvi deo se odvija tako što sve ekipe igraju po dve utakmice, svako, sa svakim, jednu na domaćem terenu i jednu na gostujućem terenu, odnosno po dvokružnom liga sistemu. Drugi deo takmičenja odnosno plejof se razlikuje od sezone do sezone.

programme.title: Football (M): Olympia - Koper, First League Telemach 2025/2026 / Nogomet (M): Olimpija - Koper, Prva liga Telemach 2025/2026
programme.desc: The Slovenian first league was founded in 1991, after Slovenia became an independent state with the collapse of the former Yugoslavia. By 1990, the Slovenian Republican League was one of the lower leagues in Yugoslav football. Until the breakup of Yugoslavia, only a few clubs played in the highest football rank of the then country. After establishing independence, only two clubs have never dropped out of the highest rank of Slovenian football, namely Celje and Maribor. The league consists of ten teams, each playing four matches - two at home and two away, the last team on the rankings falls out, and the penultimate in qualifying is fighting for existence. / Slovenska prva liga je bila ustanovljena leta 1991, potem ko je Slovenija z razpadom nekdanje Jugoslavije postala samostojna država. Do leta 1990 je bila slovenska republiška liga ena izmed nižjih lig v jugoslovanskem nogometu. Do razpada Jugoslavije je v najvišjem nogometnem rangu takratne države igralo le nekaj klubov. Po ustanovitvi neodvisnosti le dva kluba nikoli nista izpadla iz najvišjega ranga slovenskega nogometa, in sicer Celje in Maribor. Liga je sestavljena iz desetih moštev, od katerih vsako igra po štiri tekme - dve doma in dve v gosteh, zadnja ekipa na lestvici izpade, predzadnja pa se v kvalifikacijah bori za obstanek.

programme.title: Football (M): Celje - Banic Ostrava, Qualifications for Conference League 2025/2026, Finals / Nogomet (M): Celje - Banik Ostrava, Kvalifikacije za Konferenčno ligo 2025/2026, Finale
programme.desc: Since 2021, football fans will enjoy the conference league of Europe organized by UEFA. The idea for this league appeared in 2015 and includes a lower ranked team of national championships. The qualifications are divided into two parts, after which 32 teams will enter the competition, which will be divided into eight groups of four each. 16 teams will advance to the eighth finals, then to the quarterfinals, the semifinals and the finals. The winner of the final game will qualify for the European League next season. / Od leta 2021 bodo nogometni navdušenci uživali v Konferenčni ligi Evrope, ki jo organizira UEFA. Ideja za to ligo se je pojavila leta 2015, vključuje pa nižje rangirane ekipe državnih prvenstev. Kvalifikacije so razdeljene na dva dela, po katerih bo v tekmovanje vstopilo 32 ekip, ki bodo razdeljene v osem skupin po štiri. 16 ekip bo napredovalo v osmino finala, nato v četrtfinale, polfinale in finale. Zmagovalec finalne tekme se bo uvrstil v Ligo Evrope v naslednji sezoni.

programme.title: Cycling: Arctic Race in Norway: Vrhni / Kolesarstvo: Arktična dirka po Norveški: Vrhunci
programme.desc: The Arctic race in Norway is a professional stage race on the road bike. The race takes place every year in northern Norway. The idea of ​​an Arctic race in Norway - an international race in three northern Norway districts - was created in Andørja in Troms, August 2013. / Arktična dirka po Norveški je profesionalna etapna dirka na cestnem kolesu. Dirka vsako leto poteka na severu Norveške. Zamisel o arktični dirki na Norveškem - mednarodni dirki v treh najsevernejših okrožjih Norveške - je nastala v Andørji v Tromsu, avgusta 2013.

programme.desc: Just a few days after the height of the cycling season in France, there are already new challenges ahead of cyclists. programme.title: Football (M): Olympia - Koper, first League Telemach 2025/2026 / Nogomet (M): Olimpija - Koper, Prva liga Telemach 2025/2026
programme.desc: The Slovenian first league was founded in 1991, after Slovenia became an independent state with the collapse of the former Yugoslavia. After establishing independence, only two clubs have never dropped out of the highest rank of Slovenian football, namely Celje and Maribor. The league consists of ten teams, each playing four matches - two at home and two away, the last team on the rankings falls out, and the penultimate in qualifying is fighting for existence. / Slovenska prva liga je bila ustanovljena leta 1991, potem ko je Slovenija z razpadom nekdanje Jugoslavije postala samostojna država. Po ustanovitvi neodvisnosti le dva kluba nikoli nista izpadla iz najvišjega ranga slovenskega nogometa, in sicer Celje in Maribor. Liga je sestavljena iz desetih moštev, od katerih vsako igra po štiri tekme - dve doma in dve v gosteh, zadnja ekipa na lestvici izpade, predzadnja pa se v kvalifikacijah bori za obstanek.

programme.desc: The show, alternately run by Bernarda Žarn, Špela Močnik Paradiž and Andrej Hofer, will have a pleasant socializing with melodies, memories and a relaxed chat all summer long on Saturdays. With good music and fresh interpretations of hits, there is no lack of a relaxed conversation with guests about the beginnings and important turning points in their careers, musical collaborations, as well as entertaining anecdotes that have been accumulated over the years in musicians' lives. / V oddaji, ki jo izmenično vodijo Bernarda Žarn, Špela Močnik Paradiž in Andrej Hofer, vas skozi vse poletje ob sobotah čaka prijetno druženje ob melodijah, spominih in sproščenem klepetu. Poseben čar vsake oddaje so trije glasbeni gostje, ki sprejmejo nenavaden izziv – vsak izmed njih zapoje po eno pesem drugih dveh. Ob dobri glasbi in svežih interpretacijah uspešnic ne manjka sproščenega pogovora z gosti o začetkih in pomembnih prelomnicah v njihovih karierah, glasbenih sodelovanjih, pa tudi zabavnih anekdot, ki jih se jih je z leti nabralo v življenjih glasbenikov.

programme.title: Environments, pom. / Ambienti, pon.
programme.sub-title: Kdaj je smiselno iti v korenito prenovo hiše, takšno, ki dodobra predrugači zunanjost in notranjost... in kdaj je bolje podreti in zidati na novo? Včasih imajo prvo besedo čustva, glavni argument pa je stanje hiše. Zaradi predanih lastnikov in zelo nata
programme.desc: When the owner calls the architect with the desire to equip him with an apartment that has just been built, the architect finds himself a challenge to consider the existing situation that someone else envisioned. The apartment is part of a larger building in the center of Ljubljana, into which the first residents moved only last year. It now offers a lot of style, comfort and inviting views. It is no secret that luxury villas have grown in Slovenia in the recent period, the value of which has reached millions. But few of them have the surroundings as tidy as you would expect according to the design of the building and its interior. In the center of Ljubljana, we entered the garden of the villa, where the villas and the garden were formed simultaneously, hand in hand, in coordinated cooperation between the architect and the garden designer. / Kadar lastnik pokliče arhitekta z željo, naj mu opremi stanovanje, ki je bilo pravkar zgrajeno, se arhitekt znajde pred izzivom, kako upoštevati obstoječe stanje, ki si ga je zamislil nekdo drug. Stanovanje je del večjega objekta v središču Ljubljane, v katerega so se prvi stanovalci vselili šele lani. Zdaj ponuja veliko sloga, udobja in vabljive razglede. Ni skrivnost, da so v Sloveniji v zadnjem obdobju zrasle luksuzne vile, katerih vrednost dosega več milijonov. A le redke od njih imajo okolico tako urejeno, kot bi pričakovali glede na zasnovo objekta in njegovo notranjost. V središču Ljubljane smo vstopili na vrt vile, kjer sta vila in vrt nastajala sočasno, z roko v roki, v usklajenem sodelovanju med arhitektko in oblikovalko vrtov.

programme.title: All that we have always remained silent, French sequel, 4/9, Mon. / Vse tisto, o čemer smo vedno molčali, francoska nadaljevanka, 4/9, pon.
programme.sub-title: All Those Things We Never Said / Toutes Ces Choses Quon Ne Sest Pas Dites; Julia pove Robertu, da je Tomas živ in da je ga bo poiskala v Berlinu. Zatrdi, da je sama, saj tudi najboljšemu prijatelju ne more povedati, da je z njo oče.
programme.desc: Adam is furious because he is convinced that Julia is in Bruges with another man. After Michela has been weakened by a technical error, their relationship with Julia is increasingly confidential. In the meantime, they arrive in Berlin. Because Julia does not know where Tomas lives, they head to the headquarters of the journalist's Association in the hope that they keep his title there. But there is no trace of Tomas.all Those Things We Never Said / Toutes Ces Choses Quon No Sest Pas Dites / France / 20222Scenario: Marc Levy and Miguel Courtoisrezia: Miguel Courtois (El Lobo, Gal) in the main roles: Alexandra Maria Lara, Jean Reno, Aleex Brendemuhl, Bastian Hagen, Cedric Ben Abdallah, Martina García. / Adam je besen, ker je prepričan, da je Julia v Brugesu z drugim moškim. Potem ko je Michela obšla slabost zaradi tehnične napake, je njun odnos z Julio čedalje bolj zaupen. V tem času prispeta v Berlin. Ker Julia ne ve, kje živi Tomas, se odpravita na sedež Društva novinarjev v upanju, da tam hranijo njegov naslov. Toda tam ni sledi o Tomasu.ALL THOSE THINGS WE NEVER SAID / TOUTES CES CHOSES QUON NE SEST PAS DITES / Francija / 2022Scenarij: Marc Levy and Miguel CourtoisRežija: Miguel Courtois (El Lobo, GAL)V glavnih vlogah: Alexandra Maria Lara, Jean Reno, Alex Brendemuhl, Bastian Hagen, Cedric Ben Abdallah, Martina García.

programme.title: Shame, documentary, Mon. / Sramota, dokumentarni film, pon.
programme.sub-title: R: Jurjaševič Boris... Sramota; Leto 1974. Martin Uhernik je vpleten v zločin, v umor soseda Jakoba Luzarja. Na prvostopenjskem sojenju je oproščen. Za umor ni dovolj dokazov. Ker se v sodbo vpletejo nepoklicani, tožilstvo zahteva ponovno sojenje na Viš
programme.desc: At Uhernik prison, he writes letters and addresses them to various institutions, even to the marshalat in Belgrade. He proves that he is not a killer and that the court did not do right. It turns out that investigators were very superficial and that they have released many relevant evidence when proving. This is discussed by documents, judges, criminals, experts, lawyers and locals. From year to year, there is more evidence in Uhernik's written correspondence, which speak to him in favor. After a penalty, he returns to his home, in which he wants to re -live and forget the fatal mistake, which has plunged him for the bars and marked for life. The more time away from the crime, the more clear that they were condemned only on the basis of rumors and assumptions. Therefore, the defendant, together with his lawyer, submits a request to renew the process. After thirty years of Calvary, Martin Uhernik experiences catharsis: the Slovenian judicial authority annulls the judgment imposed in 1975. The Uhernik is leaving the court, and in his pocket there are acquittal and compensation, and is accompanied by an apology of the Justice Minister. / V zaporu Uhernik piše pisma in jih naslavlja na najrazličnejše ustanove, celo na maršalat v Beogradu. Dokazuje, da ni morilec in da sodišče ni ravnalo prav. Izkaže se, da so bili preiskovalci zelo površni in da so pri dokazovanju izpustili marsikateri relevantni dokaz. O tem govorijo dokumenti, sodniki, kriminalisti, izvedenci, odvetniki in domačini. Iz leta v leto je v Uhernikovi pisni korespondenci več dokazov, ki govorijo njemu v prid.Po prestani kazni se vrne na svoj dom, v katerem želi na novo zaživeti in pozabiti na usodno zmoto, ki ga je pahnila za rešetke in zaznamovala za vse življenje. Bolj kot se oddaljuje čas od zločina, bolj je jasno, da so Uhernika obsodili zgolj na osnovi govoric in domnev. Zato po krivem obdolženi skupaj z odvetnikom vloži zahtevo za obnovo procesa. Po tridesetih letih kalvarije Martin Uhernik doživi katarzo: slovenska sodna oblast razveljavi sodbo, izrečeno leta 1975.Uhernik odhaja s sodišča, v njegovem žepu sta oprostilna sodba in odškodnina, spremlja ga tudi opravičilo pravosodnega ministra.

In the center of Ljubljana, we entered the garden of the villa, where the villas and the garden were formed simultaneously, hand in hand, in coordinated cooperation between the architect and the garden designer. / Kadar lastnik pokliče arhitekta z željo, naj mu opremi stanovanje, ki je bilo pravkar zgrajeno, se arhitekt znajde pred izzivom, kako upoštevati obstoječe stanje, ki si ga je zamislil nekdo drug. Ni skrivnost, da so v Sloveniji v zadnjem obdobju zrasle luksuzne vile, katerih vrednost dosega več milijonov. A le redke od njih imajo okolico tako urejeno, kot bi pričakovali glede na zasnovo objekta in njegovo notranjost. V središču Ljubljane smo vstopili na vrt vile, kjer sta vila in vrt nastajala sočasno, z roko v roki, v usklajenem sodelovanju med arhitektko in oblikovalko vrtov.

programme.title: Einstein / Einstein
programme.desc: The Blutestal's first person in Switzerland takes a test to Tobias Muller, which determines the age of his organs. It is examined which organ -specific proteins are active in the blood and what concentration they have. If an organ is an age than the chronological age, a raised risk of illness for the corresponding organ. Studies have shown that every fifth person has at least one organ over 50 years that is significantly over chronological age. The researcher Tony Wyss-Coray has developed first-time study. The Swiss research and teaches at the elite university Stanford in the USA. The origin of his research was an experiment with mausen that was not approved in Switzerland. A boy and an old mouse were approached. The young blood has deflected the organs of the older mouse and vice versa. Biomarker in the bloodstone know Tony Wyss-Coray and his colleagues thousands of proteins that they can assign to a specific organ. Due to the composition of the blood, the researchers can shape the age of every organ. If the doctors see that an organ tackles faster, this is an additional information that has not yet been given in medicine. So you can take a closer and deeper look and then design the recommendations in such a way that you can react early before structural change. New campus in Baselin Basel Tony Wyss-Coray and the chief doctor Heike A. Bischoff-Ferrari for a campus for a healthy durability in the Felix Platter Hospital. There, people should receive fretifiable and confirmed data at their age. At the same time, research for healthy geriatric medicine is also promoted. / Der BluttestAls erste Person in der Schweiz macht Tobias Muller einen Test, welcher das Alter seiner Organe bestimmt. Aufgrund der Zusammensetzung des Blutes konnen die Forschenden das Alter jedes Organs schatzen. Wenn die Mediziner sehen, dass ein Organ schneller altert, ist das eine Zusatzinformation, die bislang in der Medizin noch nicht zur Verfugung steht.
